descricao_original: These images show cells during interphase which is the longest phase of the cell cycle and accounts for the period of time when the cell is not in mitosis. Chromatin is dispersed and the nuclear envelope is present. During interphase, the cell passes through G1, S and G2 phases, leading to mitosis. Whitefish blastula 1500x
